purpose: Prevent retired commercial language from re-entering current public assets while preserving historical files for audit/history.

authority.current_paid_motion: Customer-specific quote after Qualified Discovery -> 30-Day Revenue Command Pilot

historical_surfaces_to_treat_as_non_auth: legacy fixed pricing pages or cached copies
rules: Do not delete historical evidence merely because it is retired.
Do not select, approve, adapt or publish an asset containing a blocked token unless current higher authority explicitly re-authorizes it.
A current asset may discuss a retired token only inside an explicit historical or governance context and must never present it as the live offer.
Current public CTA defaults to Free Mini Diagnostic or an evidence-supported educational/product action.
Customer-specific price or quote belongs to a qualified deal context and is not a public content token.
